title: 每日 X 精华引用榜

items.reason: 用研究级沙箱逃逸叙事对比健身房抢课agent，一针见血戳破安全神话。
items.reasonEn: Juxtaposes air-gapped zero-day hype with a gym-queue agent, reframing agent risk as banal and real.

items.reason: 安全专家拆解「自主网络攻击」话术：用户主动要求插队，非agent自发黑健身房。
items.reasonEn: Security researcher debunks “autonomous cyberattack” framing: user asked to jump the waitlist, not a self-directed hack.

items.reason: 一句预言把健身房API漏洞推到全城预约系统 hardening 军备竞赛。
items.reasonEn: One-liner predicts reservation systems will become the planet’s most hardened software.

items.reason: 对 SemiAnalysis/Cerebras 求证后澄清 Doug 是 Astra 预训练代号，年底巨跑在其后。
items.reasonEn: Corrects own scoop: Doug is Astra’s pretrain codename; the year-end mega-run comes later.

items.reason: 用 OpenCode 真实账单 vs 双 DGX 成本算出本地推理回本要数十年。
items.reasonEn: Real OpenCode spend vs dual-DGX capex shows local inference rarely wins on cost.

items.reason: 反驳海力士「半价供HBM」谣言，细拆20–25%折扣、市占与cHBM锁定逻辑。
items.reasonEn: Corrects HBM half-price rumor with LTA discount math, share defense, and cHBM lock-in.

items.reason: 拆穿读卖「国産AI」：Sakana Fugu实为美系API编排，主权叙事与采购认知错位。
items.reasonEn: Exposes “sovereign AI” hype: Sakana Fugu is multi-API orchestration, not indigenous C2.

items.reason: 把百项目倒闭比作.com清算：市场崩不等于技术死，关键是有没有人真需要。
items.reasonEn: Reframes 100+ crypto shutdowns as .com-style shakeout: collapse ≠ tech failure; need is the test.

items.reason: 对BIP110链分裂给最终操作指引：RDTS停滞、Knots下架、闪电通道须切多数链。
items.reasonEn: Final BIP110 split ops note: RDTS stalled, Knots deindexed, Lightning users must resync majority chain.

items.reason: 对「整华为」舆情反讽：硬刚无效，捧神式造神才可能触发反噬。
items.reasonEn: Satirical counter to Huawei boycott logic: confrontation fails; deification invites real blowback.

items.reason: 前特斯拉工程师逐一点评理想/小鹏/华为智驾：端到端与高速场景差距在拉大。
items.reasonEn: Ex-Tesla AI eng. argues Li/XPeng/Huawei ADAS gaps vs Tesla are widening, not closing.

items.reason: 用真实扫楼案例补完「GitHub进货」：Docker部署开源CRM，零写码收维护费。
items.reasonEn: Case study completes “GitHub arbitrage”: deploy open-source CRM, sell install+retainers, no code written.
